overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed the Department of Public Works' response to the January 2026 snowstorms and discussed long-term staffing and equipment needs before entering an executive session to discuss litigation strategy.

items.title: Evaluation of January 2026 Snow Response
items.summary: Received and placed on file reports evaluating the January 2026 snow response, which highlighted a significant reduction in available contractors and the failure of aging sidewalk clearing equipment. Commissioner McGivern discussed long-term staffing decreases, the implementation of GIS-based route mapping, and the potential purchase of a high-capacity snowblower attachment to improve response during future severe weather events.

items.title: Executive Session: Litigation Strategy
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy regarding papers 26-053 and 26-065.
